steps: Applied migrations 0001 through 0009 to a disposable PostgreSQL database.
Seeded one scope, one completed scan, and one schedule.
Created an encrypted custom-format pg_dump and copied it to an off-host directory.
Verified the outer manifest checksum and decrypted the inner manifest.
Dropped live_scans and live_scan_schedules and deleted the scope.
Restored the encrypted backup with pg_restore --clean --if-exists.
Re-ran a second restore after deleting the seed rows and measured elapsed time.

objectives.notes: The observed RTO is a local Docker restore, not a production VPS or Supabase restore. It excludes DNS, TLS, image pull, and operator decision time.

limitations: Local Docker PostgreSQL, not a production VPS or Supabase project.
Off-host copy used a local directory; rclone/S3 transfer was not exercised.
The backup key was stored on the same workstation for the drill; production requires it outside the backup host.
No point-in-time recovery or WAL archiving was tested.
The restore window is a single run, not a sustained recovery exercise.
